who: DevSecOps engineers and platform security teams at software companies who must evaluate untrusted third-party packages, scripts, and dependencies before deploying them to production infrastructure.
agent_work: The agent installs untrusted packages and executes suspicious scripts inside an isolated Celesto microVM sandbox, monitors all system calls, file access, and outbound network attempts, then generates a structured security audit report with containment evidence.
proof_output: A structured security_audit_report.json containing risk verdict, blocked commands log, and network exfiltration attempt evidence.
